insights.detail: Engagement rate on @jatiraras.sawarga has increased steadily over the last 14 days. Behind-the-scenes kitchen videos consistently generate the highest interaction rate.
Videos published between 17:00–19:00 WIB reach significantly more viewers within the first hour. Scheduling posts in this window is recommended.
Comment volume dropped slightly compared to the previous period. Adding a question or call-to-action at the end of videos typically lifts comment counts.
Content showing cooking preparation — like sate and nasi goreng making — averages 2× more shares than product-only or promotional posts.
